exact: up regulation of translation in response to oxidative stress
up-regulation of translation in response to oxidative stress
upregulation of translation in response to oxidative stress
narrow: activation of translation in response to oxidative stress
stimulation of translation in response to oxidative stress

definition: Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of translation as a result of oxidative stress, a state often resulting from exposure to high levels of reactive oxygen species, e.g. superoxide anions, hydrogen peroxide (H2O2), and hydroxyl radicals.
label: positive regulation of translation in response to oxidative stress
